newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Five killed in southern Philippine bus shooting.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in southern Philippine bus shooting.

text.p: Five people, including two policemen, were killed in the southern Philippine island of Jolo when a group of armed men attacked two minibuses, military officials said on Friday.
The buses were entering the village of Mampalang when the unidentified gunmen opened fire on Thursday night, Major Fredesvindo Cobarrubias of the military's southern command said.
Officials said the shooting took place in an area which was a stronghold of the Moro National Liberation Front, the main Moslem rebel group which recently signed a peace deal with Manila.
